newsitem.title: SPAIN: Catalans demand health deal in 1997 Spain budget.
newsitem.headline: Catalans demand health deal in 1997 Spain budget.

text.p: The Catalans will not approve the 1997 Spanish budget draft without a better deal on health, Francesc Homs, Catalan economic spokesman in parliament told Spanish radio on Wednesday.

With just two weeks to go before the draft must be presented to Parliament, the Catalans are still holding out for 32 billion pesetas from the central government for their regional health budget in 1997.
"If this doesn't occur then there won't be agreement on the budget this year," Homs said.
Convergencia i Unio's 16 parliamentary seats help give the ruling Popular Party the absolute majority in the legislature.
